messages:
Maya (Design): uploaded a quick mock for the autoscaling / capacity panel — focusing on min/max, burst toggle, and GPU pool picker. looking for quick UX + accessibility nits. link: https://figma.com/file/xyz
Alex (Product): :eyes: looking now. main ask: make the SLO slider feel less scary for new users. we should surface a gentle default with explanation.
Samir (Eng): design looks solid. couple backend notes: GPU pools are an enum (g4, a100, l4). dropdown needs to show estimated qps per pool and cost per-hour. can we fit that?
Maya (Design): yeah — thinking of a compact two-line per-option layout in the dropdown. first line pool name, second line small text "~650 qps · $3.20/hr". open to suggestions.
Leah (Accessibility): a few a11y nits: 1) slider keyboard focus: left/right should adjust by small step (1%) and page up/down by 10%. 2) contrast for the disabled burst toggle label is 3.8:1 — below AA. need 4.5:1. 3) GPU pool dropdown should be reachable with typeahead and ARIA role="listbox" + aria-activedescendant.
Maya (Design): good catches. will update contrast and keyboard behavior. question: for the SLO slider labels — we have three preset marks (latency SLOs): 50ms, 100ms, 200ms. do we spell out "50 ms" or just "50"?
Alex (Product): spell out units: "50 ms". non-ML folks kept asking what the numbers were during demos.
Samir (Eng): backend needs to map chosen SLO to autoscale policy buckets. Also want a guardrail: if you pick <50 ms and pool is l4 (low perf), show inline warning: "Selected SLO may not be achievable with chosen pool — consider faster GPUs or enabling burst."
Maya (Design): proposed microcopy for the guardrail: "Warning: your SLO may require higher-performance GPUs or burst capacity. Expected tail latency with current pool: ~120 ms." Thoughts on tone?
Leah (Accessibility): keep it direct but avoid fear language. maybe: "Note: With the selected pool, expected tail latency is ~120 ms. Consider a higher‑performance pool or enable burst." Also ensure the warning has role="status" so screen readers announce it immediately.
Jon (SRE): on the "enable burst" option — we need a tooltip explaining burst: "Temporary burst capacity allocates spare GPU slots for short spikes. Billed per-second while active." Also add a soft limit: allow burst up to 2x reserved capacity. Ops wants a telemetry event when burst is used.
Samir (Eng): added: telemetry event name: capacity.burst.triggered with fields {team_id, pool, duration_s}. we'll add that once UI calls the API.
Maya (Design): copy iteration for the burst toggle label: current: "Enable burst capacity (recommended for spiky traffic)" shorter suggestion: "Enable burst (short spikes)". which do you prefer?
Alex (Product): prefer slightly longer: "Enable burst capacity (for short traffic spikes)" — clearer in the product.
Leah (Accessibility): long labels ok but ensure label is associated with the checkbox input using aria-labelledby, not just placeholder text.
Maya (Design): noted. also debating default min/max values. current team suggestion: min=1, max=16. should we show adaptive suggested ranges based on org size?
Alex (Product): yes — show a suggested range under "Recommended" with small text: "Based on recent usage, we recommend min 2 — max 8." Provide a one-click apply button.
Samir (Eng): backend can compute suggested ranges from 14 days of traffic. will provide API: /orgs/{id}/autoscale/suggest. returns recommended_min, recommended_max, reason.
Maya (Design): UI mock includes a small help icon that opens a short explainer modal: "How min/max affect cost and stability" with an example math snippet. any must-haves?
Jon (SRE): must include rollback guidance: what happens if min > current instances? We should show "Apply changes will restart or drain instances" if applicable. need confirmation step when changing min > current.
Alex (Product): +1 to confirmation CTA: "Apply and migrate" vs "Apply without migration" (with details).
Leah (Accessibility): modal needs to trap focus and have clear close button. provide accessible names for all examples in the explainer.
Maya (Design): I'll push an updated figma with: higher contrast for labels, ARIA notes in the spec, revised burst copy, SLO units, suggested ranges, and a small inline cost estimate next to min/max. ops-bot will post design link on update.
ops-bot: uploaded new file: https://figma.com/file/xyz?node-id=42 :thumbsup:
Alex (Product): quick acceptance criteria draft: 1) slider accessible and keyboard operable; 2) GPU pool dropdown shows qps & cost and supports typeahead; 3) burst toggle has tooltip + billing note; 4) guardrail warning appears with role=status when relevant; 5) suggested ranges shown with one-click apply.
Samir (Eng): will implement API + wiring. ETA: 2 sprints.
Maya (Design): thanks — i'll make the a11y fixes and update microcopy. will post a follow-up mock tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
